EXECUTIVE DEPARTMENT
DIVISION OF PLANNING COORDINATION
BOX 12428, CAPITOL STATION AUSTIN, TEXAS 78711
PHONE 512 475-2427
May 23, 1972
ED GRISHAM DIRECTOR
Mr. Yatis M. Barber, Jr. Chief, Office of Environmental Quality Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife U. S. Department of the Interior Washington, D. C. 20240
Dear Mr. Barber:
PRESTON SMITH
GOVERNOR
The Office of the Governor, Division of Planning Coordination (the State Planning and Development Clearinghouse), and affected Texas State agencies have reviewed the draft environmental statement for the proposed Endangered Species Conservation Act of 1972.
The Texas Parks and Wildlife Department commented on several aspects of the draft environmental statement, primary of which is the objection to the removal of indigenous wildlife forms from State jurisdiction. We concur with this objection. The comments of this State agency are enclosed.
Thank you for the opportunity to review this draft environmental statement.
Sincerely,
Ed Grisham Director
EG: jab
Encl.
